definitions.explanation: To remove the outer layer or covering of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|む}いた。
examples.english: I peeled the daikon radish with a kitchen knife.

notes:
{剥|む}く means to peel or remove the outer layer of something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {剥|む}ける (intransitive - to peel off, come off)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮|かわ}を{剥|む}く: to peel skin/rind
- りんごを{剥|む}く: to peel an apple
- {卵|たまご}の{殻|から}を{剥|む}く: to peel an egg shell

IDIOMS:
- {目|め}を{剥|む}く: to open eyes wide (in surprise)
- {牙|きば}を{剥|む}く: to bare one's fangs

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTION:
- {剥|む}く: to peel
- {向|む}く: to face, to turn toward
